title: What stangent-bug-reproducer returns (Phase 3, D75, D76)
description: A reproduction test it wrote, or why the bug can't be reproduced here. Code then builds and runs the test: it must fail on the named assertion, the quoted expected and actual results must be in the ticket word for word, and `shows` must be in the failure message (D95). A developer confirms the failure is the reported one.

target.description: The id of the test target the test was written in, as the input lists it.

testFile.description: The test file, relative to the repo root.

testName.description: The test's full name: Namespace.Class.Method for .NET; the full title for Jest, Vitest or Playwright.

line.description: The line in testFile where the assertion that checks the expected result starts.

expectedQuote.description: The ticket's sentence giving the expected result, word for word.

actualQuote.description: The ticket's sentence giving the actual result (what went wrong), word for word (D95).

shows.description: The words of your test's failure message that show that actual result, copied from the message (D95).

reason.description: For not-provable: why no unit or Playwright test can reach this behaviour here.
